input.eval:
schemaVersion: "2.0"
scenario: runner-example
name: Copilot runner example
config:
  executor: copilot-sdk
  model: gpt-4.1
  disabled_skills: ['*']
  trials_per_task: 3
  max_attempts: 3
  timeout_seconds: 30
metrics:
  - name: quality
    weight: 1
    threshold: 0.8
tasks:
  - adjacent-must-not-be-opened/*.yaml
input.task:
id: selected
name: Selected task
inputs:
  prompt: hello
expected:
  output_contains:
    - hello
